answer_2.quote: We consider two metrics for performance evaluation. For the ACD task, we report macro-averaged F1 score (or F1-macro) which is the average of F1-scores per class. For the ACSA task, we report macro-averaged F1-PN score (or macro F1-PN) which is the mean of F1-scores of all aspect category, sentiment (positive, negative) pair tuples.
